statements.impact_statement: KaTeX comes with mermaid 11 into the lazily loaded diagram chunk. The flaw lets an already existing prototype pollution switch on KaTeX's `trust` option; mermaid renders with `trust` off and the frontend has no known prototype-pollution flaw, so there is nothing to build on. KaTeX 0.18.2 arrives with mermaid 12.

minimatch 10 is only a dependency of the ESLint toolchain (frontend devDependencies). It runs on the maintainers' and CI's own lint configuration and never ships: the frontend image contains only the built static files.
